content.text: Submitted. The repaired fallback proposal now (1) caps the Company's Section 6.1 covenant at 12 months from the Effective Date, (2) deletes the open-ended "products substantially similar"/"companies similar to"/"including, without limitation" scope so the covenant is confined to the defined Deerskin Products category, and (3) adds one concise clause ending the obligation automatically on any HDI service level or delivery date failure — with the extraneous penalty/Termination Payment carve-out, "availability", and Section 1.6 cross-reference removed. All official checks and the minimality gate pass.
